Opposite Parties
 Mr. M.R. Patra, Addl. Pp
 Coram:
 Justice G. Satapathy
 Order(Oral)
Order No. 01.12.2025
 03. 1.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

This is a bail application U/S.483 of BNSS by the petitioners for grant of bail in connection with Chandrapur PS Case No.33 of 2025 corresponding to TR Case No.26 of 2025 pending in the file of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-cum-PO, Special Court POCSO Act Rayagada for commission of offences punishable U/Ss.363/ 365/366/ 376(3)/376(2)(n)/306/109 of IPC and Sec.6 r/w Sec.17 of POCSO Act, on the main allegation of abetting commission of suicide of their son and his paramour by assaulting them.

3. Heard, Mr. Sidharth Sankar Mohapatra, learned counsel for the petitioners and Mr. M.R. Patra,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor in the matter and perused the record.
4.

After having considered the rival submissions upon perusal of records, there appears allegation against the petitioners for driving out their son and his paramour out of the house and later on the son of the petitioners and his paramour were found to have committed suicide.

In such view of the matter and after having considered the rival submission and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of the offences as alleged against the petitioners vis--vis the accusations sought to be brought against them and regard being had to the pre trial detention of the petitioner in custody since 13.06.2025 with submission of charge-sheet in the meantime and keeping in view the other circumstances on record including the inherent right of the accused to be presumed innocent until proven guilty at the trial, this Court without expressing any view on merit admits the petitioners to bail.

6. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.

7. Issue urgent certified copy of the order as per Rules.
